$sources: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 4.2 (vb,0) and EN 1998-1 Sec 3.2.1 (agR): both are given by the National Annex maps
source: The Eurocodes give no towns: the fundamental basic wind velocity vb,0 and the reference peak ground acceleration agR are read from the maps of the National Annex. Choose Location: Custom and enter agR (in g) as Z and vb,0 (m/s) as V. A National Annex pack may list its towns here.
